hints.title: Jump Formulation
hints.text: Jumping from index i to j > i gains (j - i) * nums[j].

hints.title: Suffix Maximum Choice
hints.text: Notice that multiplying nums[j] by the distance (j - i) incentivizes jumping directly to the largest element in the remaining suffix.

hints.title: Dynamic Programming or Suffix Maxima
hints.text: Compute dp[i] = max_{j > i} ((j - i) * nums[j] + dp[j]) backwards from index n - 2 down to 0.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursive exploration of all jumping sequences takes O(2^n).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Formulate reverse 1D dynamic programming transition or monotonic suffix stack.
